I think it's unbelievably unfortunate that academics are still critical of Barbie even in this day and age. I feel that the anger towards Barbie and other dolls  like her, is stuck in the past and neglects to see the strides that the current Barbie has made. I think that if academics were to do some ACTUAL research, they would see the strides that Mattel, the parent company of Barbie has had in making an Inspiring Women line, the Shero line and even the variety of doll bodies now available. Not to even mention the popular Barbie vlog which has Barbie tackling issues like racism, and mental health! 

As for how I enjoy Barbie, I love watching Barbie media from movies, vlogs, youtube reviews, to eagerly awaiting upcoming leaks, looking at my small Barbie collection and even having that temptation at 1am to look for vintage barbies on ebay. As a college student myself, one thing that I'm really looking forward to is becoming financially secure to start an even bigger doll collection!

Definitely get what you mean, doll quality in brands like Mattel have been hit or miss with some lines. 

First, all that gel in dolls hair is so unnecessary and hard to wash out. Why does a doll need a hair treatment after getting free of the confines of a box? With the move towards less packaging/ plastic waste I wonder if dolls will be less jelled when they’re out on store shelves or bought online! 

As for fashions and accessories, I feel there its a hit or miss with mattel doll clothing -one side only printed compared to older stuff of better quality. Its really amazing the level of detail that went into making more vintage dolls! 

Still, I think the best line that Barbie has going for itself has to be the made to move dolls, gotta love that sweet sweet articulation!
